# omadafusion_ssid (Data Source)

Looks up an SSID by name across the site's WLAN groups. Security keys are never read into state.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "omadafusion_ssid" "guest" {
  name = "Guest WiFi"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) SSID name.

### Optional

- `site` (String) Site name or ID. Defaults to the provider `site`.

### Read-Only

- `broadcast` (Boolean) Whether the SSID is broadcast.
- `guest_network` (Boolean) Whether guest network isolation is on.
- `id` (String) SSID ID.
- `schedule_enabled` (Boolean) Whether a WLAN schedule is attached.
- `wlan_id` (String) WLAN group ID.
